test_intent.behavior: Compare raw protected output values before redaction across every JSON primitive and nested structure.
test_intent.expected_signal: Control-character strings and numeric or boolean protected segments fail the privacy gate without entering durable artifacts.

test_intent.behavior: Apply the reviewed quality and cost thresholds without binary floating-point boundary drift.
test_intent.expected_signal: Minimum case count and exact decimal boundary regressions match the core consumer contract.

test_intent.behavior: Report measured repetition variance and stable concurrent terminal failures.
test_intent.expected_signal: Repeated runs emit non-placeholder variance and failure codes are independent of completion order.

red_evidence.summary: Five evaluator correctness findings reproduced before the candidate passed: escaped protected values, minimum case count, decimal threshold drift, placeholder variance, and completion-order failure selection.
Independent verification caught protected JSON primitive leakage and sub-picodollar float rounding before the final exact candidate passed.

green_evidence.summary: The exact candidate passed the full repository gate with 223 tests.
The exact candidate passed all deterministic contract and adversarial tests.
The exact candidate passed all 10 offline golden scenarios.

anti_fitting_notes: Privacy regressions use escaped control content and raw numeric and boolean values.
Cost regressions cover both an ordinary exact 10 percent boundary and a sub-1e-12 false-pass boundary.

Concurrent failures complete in opposite orders and produce the same bounded code.

Same-account concurrent filesystem mutation remains a trusted-host concern outside V1's offline repository boundary.
